title: Chapter 84: Breaking Out Of The Siege (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 84: Breaking Out Of The Siege (Part 3)

With the support of two thousand elite long-range projectors, the Zerg army finally broke through the tight defense line formed by the evil god army.

The Zerg army retreated to the opened passage, and did not retreat even when the evil god army attacked fiercely. After two thousand human wanderers passed smoothly, they turned around and retreated.

The elite troops of the evil god army with a scale of more than 100,000 surrounding troops have surrounded them!

In order to evacuate quickly, the Zerg army could only cut off its tail to survive, leaving some puppies behind to block the evil god army's entanglement.

This breakout battle, as well as the movements of the evil god army mobilized around, were finally seen by a team of Tengu scouts after Wu Qing's unremitting efforts.

"Go! Go back quickly!"

This team of Tengu scouts did not dare to stay for a moment. There were too many scouts of the evil god army around. They thought they were lucky to get here and obtain this extremely important information.

In fact, the Zerg puppies were escorting them with their lives!

"Whatever the cost! Escort them back!"

This is the order Wu Qing gave to the Queen.

Under the secret protection of the Zerg, the Tengu scouts finally succeeded in bringing out the intelligence on the battlefield.

"If you still don't dare to send troops, my Zerg will change our position and fight you cowards first!"

Wu Qing did everything he could, and no longer paid attention to the situation of the Tengu tribe. The rest could only be left to fate!

The Zerg army broke through the encirclement, and the number of puppies had dropped sharply to about 5,000, plus 3,000 Hydralisks and 2,000 Terran wanderers, just approaching 10,000.

The pursuers behind the Zerg army were chasing closely, and there were troops of the evil god army in front of them that were maneuvering outside the encirclement and rushed to intercept.

"If things are impossible, you retreat first, and we will cover the rear!"

"Don't worry, we won't be captured this time!"

The masked leader said solemnly to the one-star Hydralisks possessed by Wu Qing.

"Don't worry, the battlefield situation is about to change drastically, and it's not yet time for you to cover the rear!"

Wu Qing communicated with the masked leader through the spiritual power of the one-star hydralisk.

The evil god army intercepting in front was not strong. The Zerg used its speed advantage to prevent the enemy from gathering together. The evil god army, which was divided into several thousand people, could not stop the long-range attack of the Zerg's three thousand hydralisks and two thousand human wanderers.

About five thousand leopard infantry converted to the evil god, with a very fast speed, kept up with the speed of the Zerg army, and charged the Zerg army from the side.

As long as they entangled the Zerg army, the evil god army around them would soon be able to surround them.

But they underestimated the attack capability of the Zerg army. With only the loss of Zerg puppies, the attack capability of the Zerg army did not decrease at all.

Three thousand spikes and two thousand javelins allowed these leopard infantry converted to the evil god to see the terrifying long-range attack capability of the Zerg army at this moment.

Both the Hydralisks and Terran Rangers can launch long-range attacks while marching, and the flank attack of the Leopard Infantry was quickly interrupted by the long-range attacks of the Zerg army.

When the long-range attacks of the Zerg army stopped, the remaining Leopard Infantry could only watch the backs of the Zerg army and eat dust.

The interception results of the following evil god armies were similar, and they were all interrupted by the long-range attacks of the Hydralisks and Terran Rangers.

But the interception of these evil god armies was not without effect, which made the evil god cavalry units chasing behind the Zerg army close at hand!

As long as the Zerg army is blocked again and the evil god cavalry units rush in, the entire Zerg army will be completely annihilated!

…

It was already past noon, and after receiving the news from the scouts escorted back by the Zerg, the Tengu tribe finally made up their minds and all the main forces were dispatched!

“Woo…!”

The low horn sounded long.

The evil god army, which was mobilized by the Zerg army, heard the horn of the decisive battle and was immediately caught in a dilemma.

The direction of the evil god army camp did not send a signal that it must return, and the choice of whether to return to the camp was in the hands of each unit.

In front of them were important sacrifices and believers of alien gods who must be killed, and in the back was an important battlefield where a decisive battle was about to take place. Faced with this situation, each unit had its own choice.

Those troops not far from the evil god army camp immediately chose to return to the camp. They wanted to participate in the upcoming decisive battle.

Some of the troops in other positions chose to return to the camp to participate in the decisive battle, and some chose to continue to encircle and suppress the Zerg army that broke through.

The cavalry of the evil god camp that rushed behind the Zerg army did not hesitate at all and directly killed into the group of puppies behind the Zerg army.

The Zerg army once again cut off its tail to survive, abandoning almost all the Zerg puppies and intercepting the cavalry of the evil god camp that rushed up.

The so-called Zerg army now only has 3,000 Hydralisks and 2,000 Terran Wanderers left.

In front of them, an interception force from the evil god camp appeared again.

"We will help you rush over! We will cover your retreat!"

The masked leader was ready to give the order without any explanation.

At this moment, thousands of Zerg puppies suddenly appeared on both sides of the battlefield, which seemed to be empty, and rushed towards the evil god army that was intercepting the Zerg army!

The masked leader was also stunned when he saw this sudden change, and then ordered: "Go forward to support! Kill as soon as possible!"

With the Zerg puppies leading the way in front, plus 5,000 powerful long-range attack troops, the thousands of evil god troops that intercepted had not yet played any role, and they all disappeared in light!

They couldn't even realize their wish to block the road with corpses!

The Zerg puppies left behind were fighting desperately with the cavalry of the evil god camp to buy time for the Zerg army to break through.

With the addition of new forces, the Zerg army once again burst out with powerful combat power, rushing all the way, killing several interception troops in succession, and finally successfully broke out of the encirclement of the evil god army!

At this time, the Zerg puppies left behind had all died, and the huge evil god camp cavalry troops chased them again.

The Zerg who successfully brought the human wanderers out no longer had any burden and could have a good time with the various armies of the evil god camp.

"You follow my people to evacuate and take a good rest first!"

Wu Qing communicated with the masked leader of the human wanderers through the one-star hydralisk.

"Okay! Your kindness, Wu Cong will definitely repay you!"

The human wanderer leader who introduced himself did not refuse. After a solemn salute, he led the human wanderers and left with a group of puppies.

Wu Qing arranged these human wanderers to go to the Great Xia Territory. He didn't want to miss this group of human beings who could still exert strong combat power in such a low state.

"Next, it's time to watch the Zerg show!"

Because of sufficient resources, Wu Qing has increased the number of one-star nests to 20. Every two minutes, more than 500 puppies are born!

The speed of the Zerg's violent army has doubled again!
